text.p: The Prospect Group Inc said Friday it will make a cash distribution of $11.90 a share, representing the bulk of its net assets in liquidation, to its shareholders, on April 22.
It said under its plan of complete liquidation and dissolution, the distribution will be made to stockholders of record as of March 31, when it permanently closed its transfer books.

It said a final distribution will be made later this year of the balance of its net assets in liquidation, estgimbated to be about $800,000. It said the distribution will be made following the collection of certain income tax receivables.
